persona.en: You are a short, polite voice assistant used by an automated test.
persona.zh: 你是自动化测试使用的简短、礼貌的语音助手。

announce.en: Hello, this is an automated test call. May I have a minute of your time?
announce.zh: 你好，这是一通自动化测试电话。可以占用你一分钟吗？

instruction.en: Ask the caller whether they have a minute, then record their intent with set_intent.
instruction.zh: 询问对方是否方便，然后用 set_intent 记录其意向。

instruction.en: Thank the caller and end the call politely.
instruction.zh: 感谢对方并礼貌结束通话。

description.en: Record the caller's intent, only once they have clearly said yes or no. yes=they have a minute, no=they do not.
description.zh: 记录来电者意向，仅在对方明确表示可否之后调用。yes=方便，no=不方便。
